title: Baton LLM Check Report
description: The structured report returned by any of Baton's six deterministic LLM check types (spec-ambiguity, design-review, ac-satisfaction, security-review, semantic-coverage, maintainability-review). Emitted as a schema-constrained structured-output call (ADR-0011), never scraped from prose. The model authors the judgement core (verdict, findings); an engine may stamp check/slice_id/release and harness telemetry post-emission, so those are validated-if-present rather than required of the model payload. Fails closed: a FAIL verdict must carry at least one finding.

severity.description: Two vocabularies are in use. Five of the six checks grade FAIL/WARN/INFO; security-review grades critical/high/medium/low. Both are accepted here so the schema does not silently redefine a prompt's contract.
